name: Baked Jalapeño Popper Dip

instructions.primary_message: Trim the ends of the scallions. Chop the bacon. Soften the cream cheese. Drain the mild diced green chiles. Shred the pepper Jack cheese. Shred the Parmesan cheese. Chop the scallions. Thinly slice the jalapeño rounds.
instructions.secondary_message:
5 small scallions
6 slices bacon
340 g cream cheese
1 (113 g) can mild diced green chiles
113 g pepper Jack cheese
28 g Parmesan cheese
Fresh scallions
Jalapeño rounds

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack 15 cm from broiler element and heat broiler on high for at least 5 minutes. On a rimmed baking sheet, add jalapeños. Broil until lightly blistered, 2 to 5 minutes. Turn jalapeños over. Add scallions to same baking sheet and broil until jalapeños and scallions are blistered and spotty brown, 1 to 2 minutes longer. Allow to cool slightly on baking sheet, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 165°C (325°F). Remove and discard skins and seeds from jalapeños. Coarsely chop jalapeños and scallions; set aside.

In a 25-cm cast-iron skillet, cook bacon over medium heat, stirring often, until crisp, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer bacon to a paper towel–lined plate; set aside. Discard remaining bacon fat and wipe skillet clean.

In now-empty skillet, whisk together cream cheese, sour cream, green chiles, garlic powder, onion powder, broiled jalapeños and scallions, and 1/4 cup bacon until well-combined. Fold in pepper Jack and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt to taste (you may not need it as this dip includes many salty ingredients).
Bake until dip is heated through, about 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with remaining bacon, sliced fresh jalapeño, and chopped fresh scallions. Serve hot with tortilla chips.

description: This baked jalapeño popper dip has all the smoky, creamy flavor of classic poppers, without the time-consuming work of stuffing and breading peppers, making it an easy, shareable party appetizer.
notes:
Notes: Avoid using pre-shredded cheese, which often contains anti-caking agents that can prevent it from melting smoothly into the dip.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container for up to 4 days. Rewarm in a low oven or microwave; stir occasionally as it warms.
author: Laila Ibrahim
